questions.cardText:
[Zoology] What is the largest big cat?
A. Tiger B. Lion C. Cheetah
Answer: A. According to Guinness World Records, the largest recorded tiger, named Jaipur, was measured in 1986 at the age of nine. He was 10.8 feet (3.3 meters) long from nose to tail tip, stood 4.1 feet (1.25 meters) at the shoulder, and weighed an incredible 922 pounds (418.2 kg).
questions.de: Welche Art ist die größte der Großkatzen?
questions.en: Which species is the largest of the big cats?

timeline.labelEn: Jaipur, a nine-year-old male Siberian tiger, is measured as the largest tiger on record in captivity
timeline.labelDe: Jaipur, ein neunjähriger Sibirischer Tigerkater, wird als größter je in Gefangenschaft gemessener Tiger vermessen

questions.notes: Card’s figures are slightly off: Guinness gives Jaipur (1986, aged nine) as 3.32 m (10 ft 11 in) nose to tail tip and 423 kg (932 lb), not 10.8 ft / 922 lb (418.2 kg); Guinness gives no shoulder height. Wikipedia (Tiger) notes the tiger is only ‘popularly thought’ the largest felid: the largest tigers exceed lions but average sizes overlap. Hybrid ligers are bigger but not a species.

questions.cardText:
[Law] In which of the following countries is it mandatory for employers to provide a 13th-month salary to employees?
A. Philippines B. Oman C. Korea
Answer: A. In many countries including the Philippines, it is mandatory by law for employers to provide their employees with an extra payment at the end of the year. In the Philippines, the payment is typically equivalent to one-twelfth of the employee’s annual salary.
questions.de: In welchem südostasiatischen Land verpflichtet ein Präsidialdekret von 1975 Arbeitgeber zu einem „13. Monatsgehalt“, das bis zum 24. Dezember fällig ist?
questions.en: In which Southeast Asian country has a 1975 presidential decree obliged employers to pay a “13th-month pay”, due on or before 24 December?

timeline.labelEn: Ferdinand Marcos issues Presidential Decree No. 851, making a 13th-month pay mandatory in the Philippines
timeline.labelDe: Ferdinand Marcos erlässt das Präsidialdekret Nr. 851, das in den Philippinen ein 13. Monatsgehalt vorschreibt

questions.notes: Card correct. Many other countries (most of Latin America) also mandate it, so the question pins the 1975 decree (PD 851) and the 24 December deadline from Wikipedia to make the Philippines the only answer.
